A global integrated energy major — a Energy & Utilities engagement delivered by a blended Dataq Software team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Turnaround scheduling combinatorial; incumbent planning stopped early.
Integrity telemetry patchy on critical assets. Emissions evidence estimated, not measured.

A Quanta solver tournament on turnaround formulations beat the classical baseline by 11% on makespan and was industrialized with warm starts; integrity sensing (corrosion/vibration/thermal) now predicts failures on critical assets; the methane/ESG spine replaced estimates with measurement.

items: the optimization was benchmarked honestly against the best classical baseline, and the result survived that comparison.
the agents ran inside a policy envelope with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
the twin drifted when the asset drifted — and the sync loop caught it, which is what kept operators using it.

blocks.x: If the global integrated energy major program reads like your own estate, the honest advice is: start with the baseline diagnostic, not with the build.
